title: AI Gateway keeps 5 metadata entries; the gateway stamps 6, so trace_id is lost
body:
proxyModelRequest stamps cf-aig-metadata with six keys (run_id, tick_id, project, epic, attempt, trace_id; GATEWAY_METADATA_KEYS). The staging proof read three AI Gateway logs back through the binding, and every one carried the first five and no trace_id. The AI Gateway keeps at most five custom metadata entries. So a gateway-log query filtered by trace_id matches nothing, and the D20 chain link 'trace id to what the model was asked and spent' (tick hyi) cannot work from gateway logs. Fix options: drop or merge a key (for example project+epic) so that trace_id survives, then add a test that GATEWAY_METADATA_KEYS has at most 5 entries.
evidence: cloudflare/src/gateway.ts:564 (GATEWAY_METADATA_KEYS, six keys); harness/proof/README.md recorded result: getLog metadata has run_id,tick_id,project,epic,attempt only
